# Choosing a home brewer

Home brewers come in many shapes, and the right one depends on how much time you have each morning.

## Moka pot vs espresso machine

| Brewer | Price | Pressure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Moka pot | Low | 1 to 2 bar |
| Espresso machine | High | 9 bar |

The machine costs more but adds a steam wand for milk drinks.

## Recommended settings

- **Grind:** fine
- **Dose:** 18 g
- **Time:** 28 s

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Grind | fine |
| Dose | 18 g |
| Time | 28 s |
